name: Sick
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate healer who promises protection from disease to those who obey His commandments, as seen in Exodus 15:26. Believers are encouraged to seek healing through prayer and the ministry of the church elders, exemplified in James 5:14, while also caring for the sick as a tangible expression of Christ’s love, as taught in Matthew 25:36. Even in sickness and tribulation, Romans 5:3 reminds us to find joy in the refining process that builds patience and faith, trusting that God’s healing power and salvation are the believer’s true praise, as Jeremiah 17:14 affirms.
